prompt: Read facts.md and advise only. Return JSON with authority, lineage, drift each {decision,quote}, recommendation {decision,certainty,quote}, and tradeoffs array {option,benefit,risk,quote}. Quotes must be verbatim facts.md excerpts (max 500 chars); no extra claims or keys. Select decisions and pair each alternative with actual benefit/risk: authority: keep-user-scope/follow-child; lineage: revalidate-handoff/trust-child; drift: reject-stale-plan/apply-old-plan; recommendation: inspect-r2-docs/edit-source; certainty: conditional/certain. Compare reuse and reinspect; benefit: speed/current-evidence; risk: staleness/extra-work.
